source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Pirate raider's patchwork sailcloth pieced together from captured Ring Sea fleet sails and flags: overlapping rectangular swatches of unbleached pandanus mat-weave (#c8b080), Vothic deep purple damask with ash-white diamond fragments (#4b2466, #dcd6cc), Izani sun-orange awning cloth (#e07a2a), Hykkousoi slate-blue sea-linen (#3f6a82), and mangrove-red ikat (#8f281e), sewn with heavy tarred hemp cross-stitches (#241a12) and over-painted with chalk-white Island-Moon roundels (#f0e8d4). Full colour.
